capabilities: Measure text height in images via Tesseract.js OCR
Rewrite image embed widths to match the body font size
Download external images and resize their Markdown references
Download and verify OCR runtime dependencies from settings
disambiguation: Does not resize image files; it only inserts or updates the width digit inside the image's Markdown embed syntax.
extras: Desktop only (Electron-dependent WASM); OCR stays unavailable until the user downloads ~12 MB of Tesseract runtime assets in settings. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author found pasted or clipped images visually jarring when scaled larger than body text and tedious to fix one by one.
problem: Pasted or web-clipped images often render larger than the surrounding body text, and fixing each image's width by hand is tedious.
summary: OCR-based resizer that rewrites the width digit in image embed syntax so text inside images matches the note's body font size.
